'''Hake in herby breadcrumbs''' is a fairly simple way of serving [[Cookbook:hake|hake]], or any other white [[Cookbook:Fish|fish]]. It has a nice crunchy texture and subtle flavours from the herbs and pine nuts. It's easily scalable. The details here are for two servings.

==Ingredients==

=== Breadcrumb mix ===
*1 [[Cookbook:cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Bread Crumb|breadcrumbs]]
*½ cup [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]] [[Cookbook:herb|herbs]] (e.g. [[Cookbook:Parsley|parsley]], [[Cookbook:Tarragon|tarragon]], etc.)
*1 [[Cookbook:tablespoon|tablespoon]] [[Cookbook:pine Nut|pine nuts]]
*2 tablespoons avocado oil or [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]]
*[[Cookbook:salt|Salt]] to taste
*[[Cookbook:pepper|Pepper]] to taste

=== Fish ===
*2 [[Cookbook:Each|ea]]. (200 g) [[Cookbook:Hake|hake]] fillets
*1 [[Cookbook:egg|egg]], beaten
*[[Cookbook:lemon|Lemon]] juice

==Procedure==
#Preheat the [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to [[Cookbook:Oven Temperatures|gas mark 4]].
#Mix together the breadcrumb ingredients in a [[Cookbook:Food Processor|food processor]], adding the oil last. It should be a slightly moist mixture.
#Dip each hake fillet in beaten egg, then in the breadcrumb mix. Try to get the fillet evenly coated.
#Place each fillet in a [[Cookbook:Baking Dish|gratin dish]], drizzling a little oil on top.
#[[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] in the oven for 20 minutes until the breadcrumbs are browned.
#Sprinkle some lemon juice on top.
#Serve with a dressed [[Cookbook:Salad|salad]].
